snippets.text:
1403| def classify_failure(subtask: dict[str, Any], outcome: Any) -> str:
1404|     """Map a rejected subtask to a control-loop failure branch.
1405| 
1406|     * ``transient`` — timeout / model-network error / crash / lock conflict and
1407|       attempts remain: retry the SAME subtask (attempt+1), plan unchanged.
1408|     * ``structural`` — forced: the executor was blocked (no tools at all), the
1409|       workspace was rejected, or the attempt budget is exhausted.
1410|     * ``rewrite_remaining`` — otherwise (wrong approach). The rewrite proposal
1411|       is still diffed: if it changes steps/deps/criteria it is escalated to
1412|       ``structural`` by the control loop.
1413|     """
1414|     stop = getattr(outcome, "stop_reason", None) or ""
1415|     error = getattr(outcome, "error", None) or ""

1498| def reset_subtask_for_retry(subtask: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
1499|     """Transient failure: same node, bump attempt, clear running fields."""
1500|     s = dict(subtask)
1501|     s["status"] = SUBTASK_PENDING
1502|     s["attempt_number"] = int(s.get("attempt_number") or 0)  # bumped when leased
1503|     s["error"] = None
1504|     s["stop_reason"] = ""
1505|     s["result_summary"] = ""
1506|     s["result_full"] = ""
1507|     s["finished_at"] = None
1508|     s["finished_seq"] = None
1509|     # Keep acceptance_evidence from the failed attempt for diagnostics.
1510|     return s

1076| def verify_subtask_node(state: WorkflowState) -> dict[str, Any]:
1077|     plan = state["plan"]
1078|     sub = P.find_subtask(plan, state.get("current_id"))
1079|     outcome = state["last_outcome"]
1080|     assert sub is not None
1081|     legacy = P.is_legacy(plan)
1082|     if (outcome.status == agent_executor.STATUS_CANCELLED
1083|             or outcome.stop_reason == getattr(agent_executor, "STOP_CANCELLED", "cancelled")):
1084|         sub["status"] = P.SUBTASK_CANCELLED
1085|         sub["verify_note"] = outcome.summary or "用户取消"
1086|         sub["error"] = outcome.error
1087|         sub["stop_reason"] = outcome.stop_reason
1088|         sub["finished_at"] = utc_now()

issues: 子任务1为 analyze 却包含 targets 且 status=to-verify 的 workflow.py:verify_subtask_node，规则要求 analysis 目标禁止 modify 且 confirmed 符号必须真实存在；to-verify 状态在 analyze 步骤中不可接受，应改为 confirmed 或移除。
子任务2的 write_scope 包含 app/engine/workflow.py，但该文件是否真需修改尚未确认（子任务1仅分析），在 bugfix 中应避免预先声明未确认的修改范围；且 targets 中 workflow.py:verify_subtask_node 仍为 to-verify，违反 confirmed 要求。

子任务2的验收标准中『classify_failure 返回 structural』与『reset_subtask_for_retry 后 attempt_number==1』存在语义冲突：reset_subtask_for_retry 本身不递增 attempt_number（注释说明 bumped when leased），验收标准要求在该函数内递增，与代码现状及子任务1的分析结论可能矛盾，需先明确递增位置再定验收。
子任务3为 modify 但 write_scope 仅 tests/test_task_graph.py，未在描述中明确是新建还是修改；该文件已存在，应确认路径精确且说明是扩展既有测试。
子任务4 verify 的 depends_on 包含 2 和 3，但未依赖子任务1的分析结论；且 verify 的 targets 仅列测试文件，未覆盖被修改的 app/engine/planning.py 符号，验证范围不完整。
整体缺少对 app/engine/workflow.py 中 attempt_number 租约递增逻辑的确认步骤，导致子任务2的修改范围可能遗漏或误改。
